description: This file is the code-behind for the LoginPage of an online examination system. It handles user login functionality for students and teachers, including database validation for students and hardcoded credentials for teachers. The code manages session variables and page transfer upon successful login.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Code-behind class for the login page, handling user authentication.

methods.description: Event handler for page load, currently empty.

methods.name: signupB
methods.description: Handles the event when the signup button/link is clicked, transferring to the Sign Up page.

methods.name: loginButton_Click
methods.description: Handles the login button click event, authenticating users based on input and redirecting accordingly.
